dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of localized, solid high-intensity pixel clusters. These asymmetrical blobs are primarily concentrated along the lower-lateral margin and between the larger macro-annuli, particularly towards the posterior end of the visible trunk.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most distinct dorsal rings form a scalene triangle.
